pricing_note: Customer price = provider COGS (tokens x model price + grounding) x flat_multiple, converted to credits at credit_to_usd. flat_multiple=1.2 => 20% markup over COGS. Supersedes the legacy provider_cost_fraction=0.65 (~1.538x markup). Per-provider representative_input_tokens/representative_output_tokens (added 2026-07-19, #1506) override the shared representative_probe ONLY for the client-side web-search lanes (ChatGPT/Claude) whose grounding tools ingest retrieved page content as INPUT tokens (~15k/probe measured, n=1443) — not the flat 2000 — so the markup actually clears COGS. Gemini/DeepSeek keep the shared default: Gemini grounds server-side (input stays ~350, and its cost is grounding-fee-dominated anyway) and DeepSeek is a cheap ungrounded verify.

representative_probe._note: Shared FALLBACK token counts. A provider entry's representative_input_tokens/representative_output_tokens override these; grounded_search_calls still applies to all.

chatgpt.notes: gpt-5.5 real list price $5/$30 per 1M (in/out) confirmed Jun 2026. Cached input ($0.50/1M) and batch/flex ($2.50/$15) can lower this once implemented. web_search_preview grounding stuffs retrieved page content into input context: measured avg ~15,078 input tok/probe (median 8,729, p90 39,241, n=1443) — NOT 2000. representative_input_tokens reflects the avg so the 1.2x markup clears COGS.

claude.notes: Grounded premium model. No production probes yet (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY unset on the agent). Tokens ESTIMATED from the ChatGPT grounded analog (~15k input); recalibrate from real Claude probe telemetry once the lane is enabled.
